Commentary.Commentary: It's quite difficult to tell if Pakistan will be happy with this or not. After the start the hosts got, it was thought that they would get to 300 at least, but the fact that Amla failed to accelerate and van der Dussen couldn't push on as much as he could, possibly resulted in that. Could be that the pitch isn't so that you can hit as much as you'd like. Shadab did well, and the rest did a good job in death overs. Ashraf's final over where he gave away just 7 runs could be the difference maker in this. Let's see how the second half unfolds.

266 on the board? Are South Africa happy with what they have? Enough? Or maybe 15-20 runs short? Only remains to be seen what Faf du Plessis makes of it. A fine day for two people on the opposite ends of a career spectrum. Veteran Amla and debutant van der Dussen were the stars of the show with the bat for the hosts. Post Hendricks' departure after the openers added 82, the two men in question went on to add 155 runs in a whirlwind partnership. The newcomer was electric and took the attack to the opposition bowlers, but missed out on a ton, while Amla crossed the triple-figure mark. Miller came in towards the end and added some quick runs, helping the side post a competitive total on the board.

FOUR! No he cannot finish it off with a dot. Full on off, Miller drives it through covers and Shadab in the deep puts in a dive but cannot stop it from going to the fence. Just 7 runs off the final over. SOUTH AFRICA FINISH OFF THE INNINGS WITH 266/2.
Full toss outside off, Miller tries to hit it but misses. Yet another dot. What a brilliant over by Faheem here just 3 off it so far. Can he finish it off with a dot?
Full toss outside off, Amla hits it to point and takes a single.
Full on middle, Hashim drives it to long on and takes a couple.
Another yorker this time outside off, Amla looks to play an unorthodox paddle. He misses it and the ball clips his pad and goes to Sarfaraz. There is a stifled appeal but turned down by the umpire.
Great start. Yorker on middle, Amla somehow manages to keep that away.
Faheem Ashraf to bowl the final over of the innings.
Right in the blockhole again, on the stumps, Hashim clears his front leg and drills it to the man at long on for a single.
Perfect yorker on off stump, all Amla can do is dig it out in the bowler's direction. Very well done.
Low full toss shaping away from around off, it's driven to sweeper cover for a single.
Amla hits this down to long on and does the sensible thing of bringing Miller on strike.
Full on the leg stump line, Miller flicks it towards backward square leg and takes a single.
FOUR! Nicely struck. David Miller wasting little time here. Quite full on middle and leg, a half-volley really, Miller flicks this hard through mid-wicket and sends it across the boundary line.
SIX! What a way to bring up his 27th ODI century. It is tossed up on off, Amla gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a maximum. Brilliant knock by him.
Shorter in length by Hafeez, David cuts it square and takes a single.
Comes down the track and pushes it to long on for a run.
Flighted on middle, Hashim defends that one.

Full outside off, Miller drives it to cover and looks for a single. Amla is looking at the ball and initially doesn't run but then he goes for it. The fielder has a shy at bowlers end but Hafeez cannot collect the ball. Would have been close had they hit the stump.
Loopy delivery on middle, Miller flicks it to mid-wicket and quickly comes back for the second.
Usman Khan is currently off the field. He's got a bad cramp in his right calf and is receiving medical attention. Hence the halt in play. Also, Mohammad Hafeez is called into action with the ball.
On the pads, Miller flicks it away for a single. A brilliant over for Pakistan. Just 3 runs and a big wicket of Rassie van der Dussen from the over.
Full on off, Amla pushes it to long off for a single.
Shorter in length, Miller tries to flick it on the leg side but gets a leading edge. The ball goes towards third man and he gets off the mark with that.
On a length on off, David blocks it off.
Good length delivery outside off, Miller tries to guide it down to third man but misses the ball completely.
David Miller is the next batsman in.

OUT! Rassie van der Dussen has to go and misses out on a century on his debut. Full toss on off, van der Dussen tries to go over long off. But he doesn't time it at all and the ball goes straight to Shoaib Malik at long off who takes a very simple catch. Brilliant innings from the debutant, will be disappointed not to get his century.
Full on middle and leg, van der Dussen pushes it to long on for a single. He wanted two but Amla was not interested.
On a length around off, Hashim guides it away towads third man for a run.
Full and straight outside off, Amla tries to hit but misses ti completely.
Full on middle and leg,  Rassies flicks it to square leg for a single.
Length delivery on middle and leg, flicked away by Amla for a run.
Yorker! Yorker on middle, pushed to mid on for a single.
Faheem Ashraf to bowl once more.
This full delivery is driven towards the mid on area for one run. And with this, the partnership between these two reaches the 150-mark.
SIX! That's outta here! Wonderful strike from van der Dussen. Back of a length and it's the cutter, Rassie stands his ground and muscles it over the square leg boundary.

Dropped! But a difficult chance though. Full and straight from Hasan Ali, Amla hits it straight back to the bowler. He reacts and tries to catch it to his right, but fails to collect it cleanly. A single is taken as the ball goes back.
On the fuller side again, attacking the stumps, lofted towards long on for a single.
Full again just outside off, driven down the ground to long off and the batsmen take a run.
Full ball in line of the stumps, driven through to long on for a single.
Hasan Ali called back into the attack.
Beautiful ball. Tossed up on off, the ball spins away after pitching and beats the outside edge of Amla's defensive bat.
On the pads, flicked away off the pad for a single by van der Dussen.
Shorter on length, Hashim pulls it towards long on for single.
Flighted around off, Rassie pushes it to cover and takes a run.
Drifting on the pads, Amla flicks it away on the leg side for a single.
Tossed up on off, van der Dussen pushes it away for a single.
Full outside off, it's drilled hard but straight to the man at wide mid off. The batsmen still pinch a single. 14 runs off this over, a big one for the Proteas.
A slight hold in play. Usman seems to be having some problem with his boots, so he's called for another pair.
Full delivery attacking the stumps, angling in again, Hashim Amla drives it aerially towards long on and gets off strike.
Fired full on middle and leg, dug out down the ground towards mid on for a quick single.
FOUR! Seems he's broken the shackles now! Taking the attack to the Pakistan bowlers here. Back of a length on off, van der Dussen stands tall and muscles the heave over mid-wicket to find the fence.

SIX! What a hit. Wowza! Rassie van der Dussen turning it up here. Full ball on off, he gets low and just lifts the slog over square leg. Uses the wrists well to roll over it and clears the fence with ease.
Angling in from around the wicket, Amla gets inside the line and tucks it behind square leg for a single.
Usman Khan is back.
Hashim has punched the ball off the back foot and picks up a single.
FOUR! Short and punished. Shadab bowls it short and around off, the ball spins away after pitching. Amla rocks onto his back foot and cuts it away through backward point for a boundary.
Flighted on off, Rassie pushes it to long off for a run.
Loopy delivery on off, van der Dussen blocks it away off his front foot.
Flighted around off, pushed to the fielder at cover.
Tossed up on off, Rassie cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
Full on middle, van der Dussen hits it down the ground for a single.
Good length delivery on leg, Rassie flicks it to fine leg for a brace.
Full on middle and leg, Hashim pushes it to long on for a run.
Good length outside off, Amla tries to guide it down the third man but misses. The ball misses the outside edge by a whisker.
Shorter in length, Rassie pulls it away for a single.
Starts with a full length delivery on middle and leg, Amla flicks it away on the leg side for a single.
Time for Powerplay 3. Maximum of 5 fielders can be outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the game. Also, Faheem Ashraf is back into the attack.
Leans ahead to this full ball and knocks it to long off to keep strike.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Spinning away from outside off, Amla drives it through the covers for a single.
Short and flat around off, punched off the back foot to long on for one.
Looped up leg break around off, Rassie tries to play away from his body but gets beaten.
The batsman comes out of his crease and pushes this to the covers.
Finish the over with a length delivery on middle and leg, Rassie flicks it away on the leg side for a run.
Off cutter by Hasan. It is shorter on length, van der Dussen tries to pull but the ball arrives late and he misses it.
Shorter on length, Rassie flicks it away towards mid-wicket for a brace.
On a length in middle and off, Amla flicks and takes a single.

Bouncer! It is on middle, van  der Dussen pulls it away towards square leg, Shadab, from mid-wicket dives to his right and stops it from going to the boundary. They come back for the third. Brings up the 100-run partnership for this duo. They look very settled out in the middle.
Starts with a good length delivery on middle, Amla flicks it away on the leg side for a single.
Hasan Ali is back for another spell.
Rassie van der Dussen stays inside the crease and pushes it to the cover region.
Waits for the ball to come to him before camping back and punching it square through point for a run.
Landed short on off and it turns away, Amla reaches out to it and slaps it down towards covers.
Goes with the spin as he pushes it through the covers for a single.
Another attempted reverse sweep, makes better connection but finds the fielder square on the off side.
Loopy delivery full in length, Rassie gets low to play the reverse sweep and gets an under edge on it which falls on the off side.
Shadab Khan to have a go with the ball again.
Full length ball on off stump, wristed behind square leg by Amla. Runs the first one hard and dives back in to complete the second as a sharp throw comes in. Nicely done.
Full angling in on middle and leg, flicked square on the leg side. Another run to the total.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Short ball into the body, pulled through square leg for one.

SIX! A fifty on ODI debut for Rassie van der Dussen. And he's been excellent since he's walked out to bat. Not looked nervous, no jitters of any sort. Has seemed perfectly at home. Back of a length on off, van der Dussen walks down the track and heaves it deep into the mid-wicket stands for a maximum.
Seaming in off the deck, Amla works it off his hips through square leg and crosses over.
Faheem Ashraf back into the bowling attack.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. End of the over.
Outside off on a good length, some shape away, run down to third man with an open face. Single to the total.
Slightly fuller in length, on the stumps, driven through to long on for a run.
Fraction straight in line, worked away into the leg side for one run.

High in the air but it's just short. A lucky break for van der Dussen. Length ball with some pace off it, Rassie comes down the track and swings across the line. Mistimes it over mid-wicket as Hafeez comes charging in from the deep. He dives forward but can't get to it. Single collected.
Full ball on off stump, pushed to the left of the bowler.
Drinks are on the field. South Africa going at a steady rate, and most importantly, have wickets in hand. They can go big towards the end. Pakistan need wickets and quickly too.
Cramps the batsman for room, targets the top of off stump with a length delivery. Rassie van der Dussen hangs his bat out to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. A single is taken.
Width on offer outside off, cracked through to sweeper cover for a comfortable single.

Appeal for a leg before but there's a big inside edge. Shaping back in from around the wicket and it's on a length. Amla is struck on the pads, but not before the ball takes off the inner edge. Lucky break for the veteran.
Short of a good length close to the off stick, Hashim Amla hops in his crease and offers a firm punch to the cover fielder.
On a length, outside off once more, played square to point.
Just ahead of a length, outside off, van der Dussen charges out and looks to go big downtown, but gets an inside edge past the leg stump towards fine leg. Single taken.
Fuller and angling down, van der Dussen looks to flick it away but is rapped low on the pads. It rolls away on the leg side and a leg bye is taken.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed to point for nothing.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Good length delivery on body, Rassie pushes it to the point.
Shaping back in from a good length, catches the batsman on the thigh pad as he looks to work it across the line. It falls on the off side as a leg bye is taken.
Good length delivery on stumps, Amla does well to play it on front foot back to the bowler.
Hasan Ali back into the attack.
On the pads, worked away around the corner for a run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller ball on off, solid front foot defense shown by Rassie.
Played to the point region by Hashim. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Errs this on the leg side, Rassie clips it away for one more.
Back of a length ball on off, punched off the back foot through covers for a run.
Ends the over with a tossed up delivery on off, Amla pushes it to long off for a single. Brings up the 150 for South Africa. And they are crusing along nicely here.
Short and spinning away, Rassie punches it off the back foot on the off side for as single
Looped up on off, pushed to long off for a run.
Slightly shorter and van der Dussen plays it with a soft hand to cover and takes a quick single.
Flighted on middle, van der Dussen comes down the track and hits itn straight back at the bowler.
Tossed up on off, the ball spins away from the batsman after pitching. Rassie cuts it to the fielder at point.

RUN OUT CHANCE MISSED! Poor from Pakistan. This was a length ball on middle. Once again Rassie gets a bottom edge to it. The ball rolls towards fine leg. The batsmen complete the run but Rassie wanted he second. He was halfway through but the throw was at the keeper's end. Sarfaraz collects it and gives it to the other end but there was no one backing up. Rassie gets back in time after putting in a dive. Had there been someone close to the stumps, Rassie was a goner.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! SHOT! In total control this time. Overpitched on off, RAssie stands tall and drives it through mid off for a boundary. Lovely!
On off, defended from within the crease.
FOUR! Inside edge and four! Fuller ball on off, Rassie gets an inside edge to this trying to play it to the off side. The ball misses the leg pole and runs away to the fine leg fence.
Amla flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Usman Khan back on to bowl.
Pulls back the length this time and van der Dussen punches it straight to the fielder.
Flighted on off, Rasssie blocks it off the front foot.
Once again shorter on length, punched off the back foot on the off side for a single.
Shorter in length, Amla guides it straight to the fielder at short third man.
Flighted on middle and leg, pushed to long on for a run.

NOT OUT! Brilliant review by the debutant and he survives. Tossed up outside off, van der Dussen went for the reverse sweep but fails to connect. It goes off something and Sarfaraz takes the catch and appeals. The umpire was happy and raised the finger. Rassie van der Dussen straightaway went for the review but the Snicko showed there was no bat or glove involved. Hawk Eye shows that the impact was outside the line so no chance of a LBW either. The on-field call has to be changed and South Africa retain their review.
Review! Rassie van der Dussen has been given caught behind but takes the review straightaway. Let's see if he has got a feather on the way through.
Shadab Khan back into the attack.
Quick single. Need to rotate strike. Outside off, Rassie cuts it to cover-point and sprints to the other end.
Similar line and length, Rassie taps it in front of him.
On off, Rassie gets behind the ball and pushes it to the off side.
On the pads again, this time Hashim works it around the corner for one.
Down the leg side, Amla tries to flick it but misses to be hit on the pads.
Outside off, Amla stays inside and punches it off his back foot but straight to the cover fielder.
Tossed up on off, Amla pushes it to covers for a single. Brings up the 50-run partnership between the experienced Hashim Amla and the debutant Rassie van der Dussen.
Drifts it on the pads, Rassie flicks it away on the leg side for a single.
Shorter in length, Rassie cuts it square straight to the point fielder.
Full on middle, van der Dussen hits it straight back at the bowler.
Flighted on off, Amla pushes it to long off for a single.
Tossed up on middle, pushed to the fielder at cover.
Imad Wasim is brought back on.
Length delivery outside off, guided away to third man for a single.
Good length delivery on leg, pushed to mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Overpitched on off, van der Dussen drives it away through covers for a boundary.
Shorter in length on leg, Amla flicks it away for another run.
Once again length delivery on middle and leg, flicked away on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery on middle and leg, flicked away by Amla for a single. He is looking very comfortable out in the middle.
Faheem Ashraf is back.
Dot to end. Rassie on-drives this to the fielder at mid on.
Flighted ball on off, pushed towards covers.
On the legs, flicked away through square leg for another run.
Outside off, driven past mid off to get to the other end.
Pushed to the cover region by Rassie.
Fires this on the pads, Rassie gets an inside edge trying to work it away.
Once again short in length, Amla punches it straight to the fielder.
Short outside off, Amla cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
Tossed up on off, pushed towards long off for a run.
On the pads and Amla flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter in length once again and this time Amla cuts it wide of the fielder at point and sweeper cover collects that one. They get a brace for that.
Short and on off, Hashim cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
WIDE! Drifts it down the leg side. Amla tries to hit it but misses. The umpire signals it as wide.
Reads the spin outside off and leaves it alone.
On the legs, Amla looks to flick it but misses it. The ball touches his leg and rolls to the on side. They cross, leg bye given by the umpire.
Rassie rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
On the pads, flicked away through square leg for a run.

FOUR! 37th ODI fifty for Hashim Amla! He may be out of form but he has got the runs here. Flawless so far. Outside off, Amla plays it with an angled bat and the ball meets the third man fence. The crowd applauds the feat.
The batsman drives this to the covers. Straight to the fielder though.
Fakhar Zaman to roll his arm over.
FOUR! Short and wide and van der Dussen pounces on that one and cuts it square through point for a boundary.
Once again short outside off, van der Dussen tries to cut but gets an inside edge.
Shorter in length, Hashim punches it off the back foot towards cover for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Amla blocks it away.
Loopy delivery on middle and leg, van der Dussen guides it towards long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle and Amla pushes it towards long on for a single. Brings up the 100 for South Africa.
Imad Wasim returns to the attack.

FOUR! Wrong 'un! Great ball. Pitches it up on middle. It goes the other way. Rassie looks to play it but gets an outside edge past the slip fielder. Tough chance for him and the ball runs to the third man fence.
A bit short outside off, Rassie cuts it well through point. Usman in the deep dives and saves a couple of runs for his side.
Good shot but for one. Outside off, driven to the man in the deep through covers.
Driven to the covers by Amla. Dot ball.
Gets behind this and drives it to the right of mid off to long off for one.
Flighted ball on off, Rassie drives it uppishly towards mid off.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Shorter in length, van der Dussen flicks it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length ball on middle and leg, Hashim flicks it away on the leg side for a single.
Full and on middle and leg, Rassie pushes it to mid on and takes a quick single. Good running between the wickets.
Good length on off, punched off the back foot straight to the fielder at point.
On a length on off, Amla guides it straight to third man for a single.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
First run in ODI cricket for the debutant! On off, Rassie punches it back through mid off to get off strike.
On middle and leg, Rassie gets behind it and plays it to the on side. Still on 0.
Lovely! Floats this wide outside off, spinning away from Rassie. He goes after it but fails to make contact.
Leg spinner on middle, Rassie plants his foot forward and bunts it down. Still not off the mark.
Short and wide outside off, Amla cuts it to deep point for just one.
Good length ball around off, van der Dussen tries to cut but gets an inside edge onto the pad. Lucky for the debutant that he didn't chop it onto his stumps.
Full and on off, van der Dussen blocks it off his front foot.
Full and on off, Rassie defends it off the front foot.
Full and on off, van der Dussen tries to block but get an inside edge onto the pads.
Good ball. Length delivery outside off, van der Dussen tries to cut it but the ball jags back in and keeps low. This results in the ball going under the bat.
Good length delivery outside off, Amla guides it towards point for a single.
Full toss. Best delivery to get on your debut. Unfortunately, Rassie can hit it only as far as mid on.
A bit short outside off, Amla eases it past covers to give the debutant the strike.
The debutant's turn now. Rassie van der Dussen walks out to bat.

OUT! Dolly! Soft dismissal. Loopy ball on middle and off, Reeza gets low to sweep this but gets a top edge to it. The ball balloons towards Hasan Ali at square leg who takes a very simple catch. So, finally a wicket for the visitors and it is the spinner who has brought it. Nonetheless, a good opening partnership worth 82 comes to an end.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.
Flighted ball on off, played back to the bowler.

NOT OUT! Pakistan lose their review. The replays confirm it was pitching outside leg and also it got a faint edge. It was tossed up outside leg, Amla tried to sweep but lost his balance, he still managed to play the shot. The ball went to the fielder at short fine leg and they picked up a single. The bowler and the keeper appealed, but the umpire turned it down. Shadab and Sarfraz had a discussion. Shadab was not very confident but his captain still took the DRS. And Pakistan, in a desperate attempt to get a wicket, have lost their only review.
Review! Pakistan have taken a review for LBW. Amla is the man in question. Looks to be pitching outside leg though.
Maiden! Excellent stuff. Around off, Reeza is happy to block it out.
Pull and miss. Not quite the length to pull, on middle. Reeza still goes after it but gets hit on his hips. 5 dots from Ali, can he make it six?
Outside off again on a good length. Not giving room to Reeza who can only guide it to backward point.
Length outside off, Hendricks cannot get it past backward point. Good stuff from Hasan.
Pitches it up this time, Reeza plays it back to the bowler with a straight bat.
Back of a length ball on top of off. Reeza punches it to mid off.
Back of a length by Shadab and Amla gets a leading edge which goes safely to the fielder at short third man.
FOUR! Wonderful timing. It is tossed up on off, Amla gets on his front foot and drives it through point. The ball is timed well and it runs away to the fence for a boundary.
Loopy delivery on off, Hashim drives it to the fielder at point.
Once again shorter in length, Amla cuts it to the fielder at point.
Slightly shorter in length, Amla guides it straight to the fielder at short third man.
Starts with a loopy delivery on off, Hendricks sweeps it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shadab Khan to roll his arm.
Good length delivery outside off, Hendricks punches it towards cover for a single.
Full on middle and off, Hendricks plays it with a front foot defense.
Shorter in length, Reeza defends it off his back foot.
Good length delivery on off, Hendricks blocks it off his back foot.
Full length ball on off, Reeza tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

Starts with a full length delivery on middle and leg, drives it towards mid on. Malik there dives to his right but misfields it. Does enough to stop it from going to the fence. Hendricks comes back for the second.
Hasan Ali on to bowl now.
Reeza goes deep inside his crease and works it through square leg for a single. Keeps strike for the next over.
Brings his wrists into play as he turns it through square leg. One run collected.
Played to mid off this time. No run for the batsmen to take.
Hendricks too comes ahead, drives it past short mid-wicket and towards long on. Another run to the total.
Tossed up delivery in line of the stumps, Amla comes forward and eases it to long on for one.
Quicker and flatter on middle stump, Hendricks goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Drifting on the pads and Reeza flicks it on the leg side for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, pushed towards long off for a single.
Reeza punches the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Shorter in length outside off, Hendricks punches it off the back foot through covers. Hafeez in the deep puts in a dive and saves a certain boundary. The batsmen pick up a brace.
Beaten! It is tossed up on off, Reeza tries to block it off his front foot and the ball beats the outside edge by a whisker.
Shorter on off, Hashim pushes it towards cover and gets a run.
Make that 6 in 6. Six singles off Hafeez's first over. Amla punches this one through cover-point to retain the strike.
5 in 5. On the legs again, Reeza works it through square leg for one.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for another run. 4 balls, four singles so far.
Played to mid-wicket region by RH to rotate strike.
Amla has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Short ball down the leg side. Reeza just taps it in the on side gap for one. Should have cashed in on that one.
Mohammad Hafeez is called into the attack.
Tosses it up outside off, Amla tries to play but misses the ball. Good over for South Africa, 10 runs off it.
FOUR! Classic Hashim Amla. It is short on off, Amla rocks onto his back foot and cuts it square on the off side through point for a boundary. Poor delivery by Imad Wasim.
Flighted delivery on middle, Hashim hits it straight back at Wasim.
Shorter in length and Hendricks punches the ball off the back foot towards third man for a single.

FOUR! Hendricks attacking Wasim. Tossed up on middle, Hendricks frees his arms and lofts it over mid-wicket. The ball goes high and reaches the fence on a bounce. Brings up the 50-run partnership between the openers.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. Now 4 fielders can stand outside the circle till the 40th over.
Amla drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Supreme control. A bit slow outside off. Amla just at the last minute opens the bat face and helps it past the keeper to the third man fence. Boundary.

Quick run and they make it. Good running. Full in line of the stumps. Reeza taps it towards mid-wicket and hares to the other end. Imad there was a bit too deep which enabled the batsmen to complete the run.
Fuller ball on off, driven straight to cover-point.
On the legs again. This time Amla turns his bat to the on side to get off strike.
FOUR! Overpitched ball on the pads, Amla with hard hands milks it through mid-wicket and gets a boundary. Good start to the over for Hashim.
Faheem Ashraf is back into the attack.
Drifting on the pads, Reeza flicks it on the leg side straight to the fielder.
Loopy delivery around off, pushed straight to the fielder at mid off. Not much spin on offer here for Wasim.
Tossed up on off, Hendricks drives it straight to the fielder at cover.
Flighted delivery on off, Reeza blocks it off the front foot.
Tossed up on leg, Reeza tries to hit it but the ball hits him on his pad outside leg.
FOUR! Bad ball and punished by Hendricks. Overpitched on leg and Reeza flicks it away hard and beautifully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length on off, Amla tries to guide it down to third man but gets an inside edge and the ball goes towards the square leg region.
Full and Amla drives it straight to the fielder at point.
Good length on off, Hashim blocks it off the back foot.
Bouncer! Khan bowls it short and Hendricks pulls it powerfully to  deep square leg for a single.
Fuller this time on off, Reeza drives it but finds the extra cover fielder.
On a good length at 139 kph around off, Amla runs it down to third man to give his partner the strike.
Drifts it on the pads again and Amla flicks it on the leg side for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Amla blocks it off his front foot.
Drifts on the pads and Hendricks flicks it on the leg side for a single.
Full on off and middle, Reeza hits it straight back at the bowler.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Hendricks tries to defend but gets hit on the pads. There is a stifled appeal by the bowler but the umpire turns it down.
Starts with a tossed up delivery outside off, Reeza hits it straight to the point fielder.
Spin early into this contest. Imad Wasim is given the ball.
Good cricket. On a length around off, Amla drives it towards point. Shadab Khan there dives to his right and stops a certain boundary. Good shot and great fielding.
Shorter in length, Hendricks guides it to third man for a single.
On a length on off, Reeza blocks it.
Good length delivery on off, Amla tries to guide it to point but he gets an inside edge and the ball goes towards square leg. Takes a run.
Full on middle and off, Hendricks flicks it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Length delivery on off, Hendricks defends it off his front foot.
Full on off, Amla ends the over with a classic front foot defense.
Good length delivery outside off, Hendricks guides it towards third man for a single.
Full around off, Hendricks pushes it to the fielder at point.
Slightly shorter than the previous delivery and Reeza blocks it off his front foot.
Once again full in length, Hendricks waits for it and opens the face of the bat at the last minute. The ball goes wide of backward point. The batsmen are quick and come back for the second.
Full on off, Hendricks pushes it straight to the fielder at point.
Pitches this up outside off, a bit of away movement after pitching. Amla watches it go through to the keeper.
Back of a length ball on that fourth stump line, Reeza looks to pull it but cannot get it off the middle. The ball rolls on the on side which enables him to cross.
Better from Usman. On a good length in line of the stumps. Hendricks covers his stumps and hits it back to the bowler.
Full again around off, Reeza gets behind it and bunts it down.
FOUR! Down the leg side, Reeza tucks it away off his pads through square leg for another boundary. Delicate.
Fuller ball on off, Amla opens the bat face and runs it down to third man to get to the other end.
Full on off, Reeza blocks it off his front foot to finish off the over. A good one for South Africa, 8 runs off it. Solid start here for the hosts.
FOUR! Second for Reeza Hendricks and second of the over. Full outside off, Hendricks gets onto his front foot and drives it beautifully in the gap through point for a boundary.
Good length delivery on off, Hendricks follows the boundary with a front foot defense.
FOUR! First boundary for Reeza Hendricks. On a length on middle and leg, Hendricks flicks it away through square leg for a boundary.
Shorter in length, Reeza flicks it away to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Full on off, Hendricks drives it powerfully straight to the fielder at point.
Fuller length on off, Hendricks guides it towards third man for a single.
Good length on off, Reeza blocks it off his back foot.
Full and a hint of inswing. Amla tries to drive it through covers but gets an inside edge and the ball goes towards the fine leg region. He takes a run.
Fuller this time on off, Hashim defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! First one of the innings and it comes from the bat of Hashim Amla. It is on a length on middle and leg, Amla flicks it away through square leg for the first boundary.
Usman starts with a length delivery on middle, the ball moves away with the angle. Amla defends it off his front foot.
Usman Khan to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Full length delivery on off, Hendricks defends it. Tight start here by Ashraf.
First sign of swing. Length delivery outside off, Reeza leaves that one. The ball swings in after pitching and goes to the keeper.
Shorter in length on middle, Hendricks hits it straight back at the bowler.
Good length delivery on off, Hendricks blocks it off his front foot.
Length delivery on middle, Amla flicks it away on the leg side to get a run. First run on the board.
First ball of the game and Faheem starts with a full length ball on off. Amla starts his innings with a watchful front foot defense.

We are ready! The fans have come out in numbers and the players have made their way to the middle. Reeza Hendricks and Hashim Amla will open for the hosts while Faheem Ashraf will start off with the first new ball. A slip in place for him. Here we go...
Toss - South Africa have won the coin toss and opted to bat first.

Welcome to the first of this 5-match ODI series between South Africa and Pakistan in Port Elizabeth. With the World Cup just a few months away and this being the first ODI of the year for these sides, both the teams would like to start it on a winning note and get their combinations right before the World Cup. The hosts welcome back their skipper Faf du Plessis for the ODIs after missing the final Test match. Coming to the visitors, they would like to put the sorrows of the Tests behind and bounce back in the ODIs. The Champions Trophy winners welcome back the experienced duo of Shoaib Malik and Mohammad Hafeez. This will be an interesting contest and lets see who comes out on top. Join us in a bit for the start.
